summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the Table 2 MIC condition matrix, reconciled APD6/DBAASP rows against primary XML/PDF/supplement evidence, and closed the prior rework ticket with database endpoint conflicts retained as cautions.
adjudication_summary: The paper is publication-grade with cautions: supported activity and sequence/database claims are source-located, while linked database rows that mislabel Table 2 condition MIC values remain source_conflict rather than being normalized away.

materials_exhausted.note: The relevant local XML/PDF/supplement/database surfaces were opened for the worker-2/4/6 blockers; no remaining owner-layer material gap blocks publication-grade review.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 and DBAASP sequence/literature links are source-located to supplementary Figure S1/article metadata; row-level activity values are matched to Table 1/2 where supported, with endpoint/condition mismatches retained as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1 MIC/MBC rows and Table 2 S. epidermidis condition MIC rows are recovered with units, target species/strain where available, assay methods, and XML/PDF locators; no human cytotoxicity/hemolysis rows are present in local source.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism language is bounded to viability, TEM morphology, and haemocyte localization evidence; no unsupported molecular target is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: The prior open ticket is closed after source review; remaining database endpoint/condition mismatches are explicit nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.impact: Primary source supports Table 2 MIC condition values, but linked database rows label them as MBIC/MBC without condition context; retained as source_conflict.
Database uses Alkalihalobacillus clausii while the paper table uses Bacillus clausii; database note and primary methods support synonym handling.
Activity/toxicity final intentionally contains no fabricated hemolysis or mammalian cytotoxicity row.
Mortality figures are represented qualitatively/with text-reported approximate values only; no invented exact bar values.
